properties.description: The link is the filter: a rendering a Decision or Capability points at is captured into the store; one nothing points at is NOT, so the store does not fill with session litter; and the capture happens without the agent choosing to invoke it, which is the load-bearing half — a capture that depends on remembering decays exactly as req:skill-use-survives-a-long-session measures. PLANNED.
properties.name: The link is the filter: a rendering something points at is captured, litter is not
